policy: Train only genuine channel data with explicit original permission; no mirror-license substitution.

candidates.attribution: Almeida & Hidalgo, UCI SMS Spam Collection
candidates.evidence: Official UCI terms previously fetched and archived locally at data/raw/uci_terms.html; original dataset explicitly permits sharing/adaptation for any purpose with appropriate credit. See docs/dataset_research_id.md.
candidates.curated_counts: Computed from actual archive in reports/curation.json, not copied from popular mirror counts.
candidates.transformations: Strip body, normalized exact dedup, remove conflicting labels, template/near-duplicate grouping and grouped splitting; preserve original ham/spam labels.
candidates.privacy: Historical conversational SMS may contain PII; raw/processed messages remain local ignored files, audit publishes row handles only. Source-level English includes informal mixed varieties.
